name: Foseco Crucible (India) Limited
about: Foseco Crucible (India) Limited manufactures and sells silicon carbide and clay graphite crucibles, and its accessories in India, Asia and Far East, Europe, Africa, the Middle East, the United States, and internationally. The company offers crucibles and accessories for melting, holding, treatment and casting applications, including ferrous and non-ferrous metals and alloys, as well as provides silicon carbide crucibles, clay graphite crucibles, and foundry and allied solutions tailored for both ferrous and non-ferrous metal sectors. It also offers feeder sleeves and risers, coatings for sand molds and cores, filters and gating systems, metal treatment for nonferrous alloys, melt shop refractories and flow control, crucibles and retorts, die coatings, binders and moulding material, and ferrous metal treatment, as well as foundry and technical services. The company serves mining, automotive, industrial machinery, electrical equipment, and railway sectors. It also exports its products. The company was formerly known as Morganite Crucible (India) Limited and changed its name to Foseco Crucible (India) Limited in February 2026. The company was founded in 1856 and is based in Aurangabad, India. Foseco Crucible (India) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Foseco India Limited.
